mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During expansionary industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 100), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong manufacturing output supporting corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening housing market that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 295) indicates persistent inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 295, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In weak labor market regimes (PAYEMS < 150000), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 150000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
